seo.title: {name} | A small hotel above the sea
seo.description: Twenty-two rooms on a cliff above the bay, with a stone spa, a terrace kitchen and boats to hidden coves.

film.order: hero gallery-rooms facts-house gallery-days voices-guests visit-location finale

hero.title:
Stay where the
tide sets the time
hero.text: Twenty-two rooms carved into the cliff, a stone spa, long lunches on the terrace and the bay below.

gallery-rooms.title: Twenty-two rooms, each facing the water

items.title: Sea View Suite
items.text: 48 m², sleeps 2. A balcony onto the bay. From €420 a night.

items.title: Garden Room
items.text: 32 m², sleeps 2. Terracotta floors under the olive trees. From €260 a night.

items.title: Beam Loft
items.text: 55 m², sleeps 3. The old hayloft with a freestanding bath. From €380 a night.

items.title: Cliff Villa
items.text: 110 m², sleeps 4. A plunge pool on the cliff edge. From €890 a night.

facts-house.title:
Built from the
island's own stone
facts-house.text: Quietly restored, the house keeps its old rhythm: shutters open with the light, lunch is long and nobody hurries.

items.title: Stone Spa
items.text: A candlelit pool cut into the rock, with island salt and oils. Open daily 9 to 21.

items.title: Terrace Kitchen
items.text: Fish from the morning boats and vegetables from our garden. Lunch and dinner.

items.title: Hidden Coves
items.text: Our wooden boat takes you where only the water goes. Tuesdays and Fridays.
The quietest, most beautiful week we have had in years.
items.name: Sophie and Tom

items.text: Woke up to the sea every morning. The breakfast alone is worth the trip.
items.name: Ana R.

items.text: Perfectly small. You feel like a guest in someone's home.
items.name: Clara D.

visit-location.title:
Close to everything,
far from it all
visit-location.text: We collect you from the airport in our own car. Just tell us your flight.

finale.title:
Seven nights for
the price of six
finale.text: From October to April, and first word on summer dates.
